exposure.needed: whether the environment has custom setups that depend on reading the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label from Strimzi pods or Services

consequence.statement: Custom setups that depend on the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label will not find it on Strimzi-managed pods and external listeners Kubernetes Services after the upgrade.
consequence.remediation: Identify any custom setup leveraging the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label and update it to use the strimzi.io/pod-name label instead.

assertion.statement: The statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label has been removed from Strimzi-managed pods and external listeners Kubernetes Services; custom setups depending on this label should use strimzi.io/pod-name instead.
